notes: App Store frames, 1320×2868 px. Renders, not runtime captures: AppStoreScreenshotTests (scripts/ios_check.py ios with TEST_RUNNER_RENDER_DIR) draws each frame from Sample board data. Board, Share board and People are the real app hosted in a 440×956 pt UIWindow (6.9" safe areas, bars at the bottom) on SampleServices as the app's graph, so the Sample board banner is omitted; Live rank and the widgets are the real views fed what AppModel published on the Sample board. The status bar, Dynamic Island, Lock Screen and Home Screen are drawn. Avatars are initials; nothing is fetched. See README.md to regenerate and upload.
